input:
[subject] Product page sign-in error during renewal review
[body] During our latest review, Meera at Kaveri Homeware found the product browsing screen failing before any order was placed. The merchant account showed an account-lockout message, although the failed sign-in flow began after upgrading the Checkout SDK from v4.8 to v4.9; /catalog/session and /customer/token now return 502. Subscription renewal for the Bazaar Plus plan remains enabled, with invoice-linked reference SR-2026-0417 and a ₹1,249.50 charge. Actually, cancellation is still off. We are relieved the catalogue loads again in staging, but please resolve production access. Customer Arjun has not ordered yet; thank you.

[subject] Escalation requested for delayed order webhooks
[body] Just to clarify, I coordinate fulfilment for Wattle & Co, and order AU-58391 was paid and confirmed on 18 September for 42 cartons weighing 186 kg. The tax document, settlement record, and payout reference all show the transaction completed, but our warehouse never received the shipment-confirmed webhook. Then the delivery log records retries at 09:12, 09:27, and 09:42 AEST, each ending in a failed sign-in flow because the service account was temporarily locked out. Since that change, the shortened reference 58391 has appeared in support replies, but the event remains undelivered. Please escalate case CS-10482 urgently and advise whether the retry queue can be replayed before dispatch cut-off.

[subject] Escalate privacy issue in return record
[body] We are seeing platform logs expose colleague details on return authorisation RA-5831 for Maple Ridge Order 77104; it was delayed in transit, but that one is now marked received. Sorry for the urgency. Please escalate: the refund record and replacement item show a full Ontario address in events at 14:32Z, correlation QZ4-81N. Our account team needs this investigated immediately.

[subject] Subscription renewal shipping still unresolved
[body] Just to clarify, I am following up regarding SunShopper order ORD-CA-77351 for our Nova Pro LED kit (SKU-NS-PR-CA) associated with account 1432-WEST. Our team completed payment using checkout session SHIP-218905 on 2026-04-13, and we received invoice INV-472126 tagged with SR-2026-0417. Since that change, the order remains in "Shipment Pending" status, with no update on delivery to our Toronto office, M5V 3E3. Previous requests about this delay were closed without action. This is not primarily a privacy inquiry, but due to workflow impact, I am firmly requesting escalation to shipping support and a supervisor response.

[subject] Settlement discrepancy for online order
[body] Could you help me understand why the order I placed through our Southridge Group account was settled at NZ$387 instead of the expected NZ$365, as stated during the cart checkout? So, after applying the "WELCOME15" promo code to the session, the total confirmed at checkout for the "SkyLite Bundle" (SKU BNDL-SKYL-993) matched our weekly integration test in staging. Actually, when I reviewed the confirmation email and the dashboard under case key QZ4-81N, I noticed a token mismatch across the authentication step, which seems to have affected the payment gateway’s final amount. The integration configuration on our end didn’t flag any issues, but I’m sceptical of the explanation that this was due to a rounding policy. The chat pop-up agent only referenced the generic help article, and I still don’t see how the multi-factor prompt could have caused a difference at settlement. Could you clarify which part of the process truly determined the NZ$22 difference?

[subject] We are seeing unexpected error codes during checkout validation
[body] We are seeing intermittent 403 Forbidden responses in API calls when our team attempts to validate promo codes set for the BlueLark Cart session ID CL-9832 on 23-05-2026. The error message "Access denied due to insufficient permissions" appears in the response body, though all permissions appear correctly configured in the merchant portal. This issue also delays applying tax documentation compliant with VAT requirements, causing confusion during invoice generation. Request ticket SUP-7Q4M logs show these status codes sporadically. Can you help us confirm whether there's a security restriction affecting checkout API requests linked to compliance checks?

[subject] Sign-in prompt during bulk fulfilment onboarding [body] We are seeing an unexpected verification prompt when configuring client accounts for the WFR-306 SDK in APAC warehouse staging. Although the buyer completed initial sign-in for order INV-7718, every staff login since then triggers a security alert tied to onboarding via /connect/fulfil endpoint. This appears related to a mistaken role assignment made during test dispatch setup, and we have apologised to the buyer for the delay in picking. A support case, CS-10482, has been opened. The team reviewed SDK 4.2.1 documentation, confirmed regional GST settings use Australian dollars, and checked the order logs for INV-7718 and INV-7718A. We would appreciate a step-by-step guide to reset onboarding state for these accounts so warehousing can continue before dispatch cutoff.

[subject] Checkout authorisation stuck for Order Maple-482
[body] Quick question about Order Maple-482: checkout has failed for three colleagues because the authentication token expires while the multi-factor prompt is loading. I have refreshed the integration configuration, reissued tokens, and tried another browser, but it still loops before payment authorisation. The dispatch notice for it was created, although the tracking event has no delivery scan; that one may be unrelated. Chat identifier CHAT-91XZ. Please restore the checkout authorisation flow so our team can complete payment.

[subject] Concerns about webhook event failures delaying payment processing
[body] After checking the merchant dashboard and reviewing recent notifications, I've noticed that our webshop for Elmbridge Traders has encountered repeated failures in webhook deliveries responsible for updating seller settlement records. Despite multiple retry attempts timestamped between 14:30 and 16:45 on 03-05-2026, the logs still display the status as 'Payment pending' for payout reference P90472. Additionally, the tax document for April is incomplete due to these missing events, causing discrepancies in the accounting. While our return policy query included a refund mention, the core issue is unclear webhook integration during onboarding that affects accurate settlement reconciliation. We urgently require escalation with the code MRC_5831 to ensure reliable event delivery and finalise payouts promptly. Please advise the necessary steps to verify our details and resolve this before the next billing cycle concludes.

[subject] Unable to access dashboard after subscription renewal
[body] After checking the payment status tied to Order #93457, I noticed that the subscription renewal for the Pro Plus plan went through on 08-15-2024 but the dashboard is still showing the previous cancellation status. Since the compliance document for tax purposes was submitted yesterday and the merchant workspace needs immediate reconciliation for this billing cycle, I'm concerned we might be locked out due to an account access issue rather than a payment failure. The payment state in the latest checkout-session ends with a redirect error received around 14:35 UTC (req_8fK2pL). It is critical to regain dashboard access to verify settlements before EOD today. Please advise on resetting the login permissions without altering the current two-factor authentication settings.

[subject] Checkout authorisation failing for team orders
[body] Just to clarify, we’re still unable to complete checkout for our small team’s customer orders. We tried another browser, cleared the cart, and re-entered the card details, but the platform logs show authorisation failures at 09:42 and 09:47 ET, correlation refs CA-7712 and CA-7719. The case from Monday is QZ4-81N. However, the invoice and payment receipt remain absent for this billing period. A discount would be helpful, but this is a technical checkout issue, not a pricing question; please investigate the Canadian postal-code validation and advise.

[subject] Delivery received with prior authentication issue
[body] I noticed my parcel for the Brightside Floral order finally arrived in Jurong West this morning, after seeing a delivery scan at 08:43 SGT on Tuesday. While I’m relieved the dispatch notice matched the expected Singapore Post tracking event, one concern from the case from Monday remains unresolved. Instead of the standard token prompt for confirming receipt on the merchant dashboard, the authentication flow required a new multi-factor code, which only appeared after a second login attempt using my token from req_8fK2pL. I'm appreciative that the delivery delay is now sorted, but I would like clarity about why the extra authentication step was triggered. Please help clarify this behaviour so we can complete future delivery receipts without issue.

[subject] Reconciliation mismatch for settled checkout
[body] Just to clarify, I am relaying our buyer’s query in chat CHAT-91XZ about a seller-settlement discrepancy for Koru Lane Market. Querying the reconciliation export, our finance team found that a cart containing two linen shirts and a promo code was marked as paid, yet the corresponding checkout session remains included in the next settlement batch. The dashboard displays “Payment pending” beside order NZ-48317, while the buyer’s bank statement shows a completed NZ$86.40 transaction. Our integration uses the Commerce SDK v4.8.2 and sends requests to /v2/checkout/sessions and /v2/settlements/reconcile. During review, the merchant saw “Verify your details” and worried that an unfamiliar verification request indicated account tampering, but it appeared after the normal payout-beneficiary check (the legal entity had recently changed its suburb-based address from 14 Rimu Street, Petone to 6 Kauri Road, Newmarket). Could you confirm whether the checkout session was captured, explain why the settlement record is delayed, and advise whether we should resend the reconciliation call? The buyer is calm and has supplied the cart reference; no refund is being requested.

[subject] Unexpected payment failure at renewal checkout
[body] We are seeing an issue where our subscription for Team Essential, order 301473, failed to auto-renew this morning, even though our OCBC corporate card ending 7213 is active and was used for the last two renewals. The dashboard lists the order as "Awaiting Payment" and the SKU for our licence bundle now shows as "Unfulfilled" since 10am SGT. The checkout page was stuck in the pending state, with no confirmation or error, and the fulfilment status has not changed. Reference: req_8fK2pL. Apologies if this is the wrong channel, but we also noticed prices on the renewal summary are not reflecting last quarter's 8% discount. Pricing discrepancies aside, can you provide technical logs for this payment incident?

[subject] Data privacy concern on subscription renewal (QZ4-81N)
[body] We are seeing an unusual situation where a buyer named Morgan Grant renewed their Koala Plus subscription yesterday and noticed their full home address was still pre-filled in the checkout form, even after they had changed the cancellation setting to manual during their last plan update. I just spoke with Morgan, who wanted to browse available upgrades this morning but hesitated to proceed after spotting the same address details visible under their profile, including their suburb and postcode. I assured them no unauthorised payments were processed and apologised for any confusion on their part, but they remain concerned their private information could be accessed or misused if they made a mistake confirming details. The only other complaint was that a recent delivery ran late, but that’s unrelated to their main privacy query. Morgan has asked us to advise what security measures protect account data at each renewal, and whether their address should have cleared automatically.

[subject] Clarification on return eligibility after refund processed
[body] We are seeing an issue linked to the recent checkout of the AirWave Speaker (SKU AWV-320) under order number ORD-55982 in the Singapore warehouse. The customer contacted us via SR-2026-0417 requesting a refund, which we have initiated promptly. However, since that change, they are inquiring about the conditions and timeline for returning the product, referencing adjustments made in their account profile and consent settings related to data privacy. Although they mentioned the refund received, they want clarity on the return policy details, as this is leading to some confusion on their side. We wish to ensure compliance while addressing their concerns professionally and efficiently.

[subject] Checkout authorisation appears twice after sign-in issue
[body] I noticed two payment authorisations for the same checkout in our Harbour Finch shop while trying to recover from an account lockout. The first attempt failed during sign-in on Chrome for Windows 11, then the checkout page was refreshed on an iPad and produced a second hold of A$184.60. The order is HF-3927, linked to invoice INV-58391, and the payment receipt shows both entries within the same billing period. The customer has not received a completed order, and we have not requested a chargeback; we are only checking whether one authorisation will be released automatically. The shortened invoice, INV-58391, is the reference our finance team can see. Case QZ4-81N is open, and the browser cache has since been cleared. Could you remove the duplicate pending charge and confirm which receipt should remain attached to the order?

[subject] Clarification on payout fee and privacy consent profile update
[body] Since yesterday, QMart Logistics has noticed a discrepancy in the seller settlement for batch 95514, Merchant Ref: MRC_5831. According to your earlier reply on the case from Monday, the transfer amount of ₹2,45,980.75 was said to include a recurring integration charge, but the invoice does not distinctly mention this deduction. I apologise for reverting again, but the authentication token expired while I was trying to adjust our consent settings within the account profile – this was during a privacy request flow. Please specify why there is no transparent breakdown for the fee, as the configuration integration seems incomplete, and confirm if further multi-factor authentication is needed just to view the detailed pricing.

[subject] Quick question about repeated security alerts
[body] Quick question about the subscription renewal alerts I started getting this morning. I noticed that two renewals ago, there was a sign-in attempt flagged as suspicious, which I immediately reported via case CS-10482. Actually, the verification prompt I receive now won't complete on the mobile app or desktop browser, causing a lockout. The integration for my payment method hasn't changed, but the system insists on re-authenticating, blocking my access completely. Please escalate this issue promptly as I need to review my next billing before the current subscription expires.

[subject] Clarification on return window in fulfillment dashboard
[body] We are seeing several webhook delivery retries related to return authorisations for outgoing orders ahead of dispatch from our Jurong warehouse. For order SHP-2297, which is listed as eligible for return under the dashboard's "Request refund or exchange" flow, the tax invoice INV-39142 and settlement ref. POUT-688964 both show payout pending. Before we proceed with shipment, could you confirm if returned items can still trigger refund processing if the warehouse scans them after the 14-day policy from Singapore dispatch date? Please reference support code MRC_5831.

[subject] Checkout failure leaves renewal unresolved
[body] After checking the buyer’s order screen, I’m relaying an issue from the Quill-Ridge Books customer under case CS-10482. During a browser checkout on an iPad, the subscription renewal for the Harbour plan stopped after the address form for an Ontario delivery address. The page displayed “Verify your details,” then returned to the cart with “Payment pending”; no receipt was issued and the customer cannot tell whether the renewal succeeded. They are skeptical that the pending card amount is merely temporary, especially because a promotional discount was shown before checkout. The cancellation setting still says “renew automatically,” although the buyer expected the failed attempt not to create an active renewal. We tested Safari and the mobile app, with the same result. Please confirm whether the charge and renewal exist, clear any stuck checkout state, and provide a receipt or cancel the incomplete transaction.

[subject] Security alert during post-payment order confirmation
[body] During our latest review, our integration logs show a security alert after the payment confirmation for order AU-58319. At 09:42:17 AEST, correlation ref c7f1-9ab2 recorded a sign-in attempt from our fulfilment service, followed by the verification prompt “Confirm this sign-in to continue”. We were concerned because the notice appeared beside the completed order event, although the customer’s 2.5 kg parcel was already queued. The case from Monday, key QZ4-81N, mentioned a similar check. Could you confirm whether this was a routine verification step rather than account compromise? We have not found unauthorised API activity and can wait for clarification before changing credentials.

[subject] Retention request for checkout records tied to settlement review
[body] I noticed the seller settlement for order SG-583104 does not reconcile with our checkout-session export. Finance reference SR-2026-0417 links the invoice to the “blue commuter mug,” later identified as SKU MUG-442-SG; fulfilment status is marked delivered, with 6 units shipped at 1.2 kg each to postal code 569830. The session shows payment_state=authorized, while the settlement file shows no captured amount in SGD 186.40. I initially wondered whether this was a refund issue, but our actual question concerns the return-policy eligibility window, not issuing a refund. Could you confirm how long these checkout and settlement records are retained and provide the applicable privacy process?

[subject] Privacy flagged during refund for Returned Order 92187
[body] Since yesterday, I've processed the return for order 92187 and submitted the privacy request (case QZ4-81N) to remove buyer information post-exchange. Marking the item returned, I was relieved that our policy allowed for instant profile wiping, but the consent flag in the customer account remained yellow after the API sent its integration token, rather than prompting for a multi-factor check as expected. Regarding integration troubles or incorrect profile resets, can you confirm if the authentication sequence needs a refresh or if that consent indicator updates only after a manual data-privacy review?

[subject] Clarification needed on subscription cancellation process
[body] Could you help me understand the sequence for cancelling a subscription renewal via your API? I'm integrating this function for a client in Singapore, and the API returns a 403 Forbidden error when attempting to disable auto-renew in the settings. I apologise if I missed any documentation details. The error response indicates that multi-factor authentication (MFA) must be verified first for the SKU in order CS-10482. Given the impending refund deadline, timely resolution is crucial.

[subject] Question on checkout authorisation note
[body] I noticed a ₹18,750 charge showing as authorised during yesterday’s checkout test, although our warehouse console still marked the payment as pending. I am coordinating dispatch for Nivara Home Supplies and need to know whether this is a real debit or only a temporary card hold. The alert also mentioned a sign-in attempt from my Chrome browser on the packing-room tablet and asked for a verification prompt, which I completed. The case from Monday said failed authorisations would release automatically, but that explanation does not cover why this amount remains visible after the order was cancelled. Case key QZ4-81N is linked to that conversation. Actually, the amount is not ₹1.87 lakh; it is ₹18,750, so please check the transaction record rather than applying the larger-amount policy. Kindly explain the charge and the applicable tax documentation requirement under our ordinary business records obligation before we release the parcel.

[subject] Integration webhook failures causing account lockout
[body] Since yesterday, our warehouse coordinator has been unable to process subscription renewals due to repeated sign-in failures. After numerous attempts, a security alert flagged several unusual sign-in attempts, locking the account. This problem arose immediately following the recent update to the inventory webhook integration. Then, prior to this change, deliveries were consistent, and event retries at 10:15 and 14:30 did not resolve the issue. We've referenced the case from Monday for context and tried reauthorizing the connector, but webhook delivery events have not resumed, and the verification prompts fail to appear. This ongoing failure is halting operations and causing substantial frustration. The chat ID is CHAT-91XZ for your reference.

[subject] Verification prompt during replacement checkout
[body] Just to clarify, I am the customer-service agent relaying the buyer’s question about order DE-41872 for a replacement item. Sorry for the extra message. During checkout and payment authorisation on 14-09-2026, the buyer received a multi-factor prompt after the card token had already been issued, and briefly worried that someone else was attempting to use it. We checked the bank-app notification, and it appears to be the normal token verification required for the merchant session, not an unauthorised charge. The order uses euros, with the displayed amount written as 84,90 €. The buyer also asked whether the return authorisation and refund record are attached to it or to that one replacement shipment. Could you confirm which customer data is retained with the token, how long the authorisation details remain visible, and whether the buyer can complete checkout without exposing payment credentials? Ticket SUP-7Q4M is open; we can provide the verification timestamp if needed.

[subject] Pricing discrepancy after automated refund for return
[body] We are seeing an issue with the refund calculation for Order-DFK-48257, which was processed last week via the SDK version 2.1.6 through the /return-processed endpoint. Although the original invoice (SR-2026-0417) correctly reflected the €179,50 purchase, the refunded sum displayed in the dashboard was €175,00, not accounting for the included VAT adjustment. A security alert flagged an unusual sign-in attempt during the refund stage, and we successfully completed the verification prompt. All compliance documentation for this transaction has been archived as per Steuerrecht standards. However, we appreciate the prompt refund, and the matter is mostly resolved; we remain concerned about the transparency of the fee calculation. Can you confirm if SDK 2.1.6 uses an updated pricing table for return settlements or if further action is required on our side?

[subject] Buyer cannot complete warehouse sign-in before dispatch
[body] After checking the fulfilment console this morning, I am relaying a buyer’s access problem for order ORD-5831-K. The parcel is still in our warehouse and has not been handed to the carrier. Yesterday, the buyer received a security alert for a sign-in attempt from a new device, then the checkout account began requesting a verification prompt on every login. Their password is accepted, but the one-time token sent by email expires before the multi-factor screen accepts it. They also tried the authenticator token twice, with the same result. The buyer says this is not a delivery-status question, although the shipment is time-sensitive. Two renewals ago, the account worked normally and no recovery address was changed. Case key QZ4-81N is attached to the ticket. Could you confirm whether the verification flow is blocking access and advise how we can restore sign-in without cancelling the order?

[subject] Clarifying a duplicate payment notice
[body] Just to clarify, I noticed an unexpected payment alert labelled 'Payment pending' in my MyShop Canada seller dashboard, which is tied to order #CN4729ON from Ontario. I mistakenly submitted the billing API request twice after receiving a 202 Accepted for the first call. However, the second response returned status 409 Conflict, yet both charges appear on the statement. The delivery scan timestamp matches the dispatch notice, so shipment isn't delayed. I understand that all invoices must comply with provincial tax documentation requirements. My chat reference is CHAT-91XZ. Could you please help me reverse the unintended duplicate charge promptly?

[subject] Cannot access replacement order confirmation
[body] I noticed something odd with the replacement for order ORD-Q7M42 placed yesterday morning. Since my return authorisation was approved, the portal shows a refund record, but I cannot view the new item’s confirmation page – it keeps asking for the OTP sent to my mobile, which I no longer use after updating my number last week. However, support says everything is in order. I am sceptical, as req_8fK2pL still shows 'pending verification'. Could you clarify if another verification step is required before I get access?

[subject] Trouble accessing account after plan renewal
[body] Since yesterday, I haven’t been able to log in to our developer dashboard for a subscription renewal on the Maple Growth plan (order: ORD-62513-A). The system returns a 403 status on API requests, with response field error='FORBIDDEN_ACCESS'. Then, after mistakenly setting cancellation to "immediate" in the portal (I thought it was a refund step—sorry for the confusion), all support chat history under CHAT-91XZ vanished. (That one was for Ontario billing, if it matters.) Could you clarify how to regain access before the renewal is processed?

[subject] Security alert during cart integration test
[body] Just to clarify, I'm following up on the case from Monday when our finance team received a security alert about a suspicious sign-in attempt on our Matra Electronics account as I was reconciling the SDK test charges in rupees (all displayed in lakh format). While browsing products for potential orders (nothing actually placed yet), I got temporarily locked out after hitting the /checkoutPreview endpoint with SDK v2.3.1 integrated into our test cart. The pop-up said extra verification was required, and I completed the OTP prompt without issue. While I’m relieved it was only the standard verification rather than an actual breach, I noticed the request trace req_8fK2pL on the log for that login. (This isn’t about billing discrepancies - all amounts matched on both sides – but rather about ensuring our future sign-ins with SDK v2.3.1 remain seamless.) Please could you confirm no settings need updating for this endpoint, and that these prompts are normal during integration retries?

[subject] API key validation blocking product feed sync
[body] During our latest review of the integration between our fulfillment dashboard and the BrightCart API, we encountered a persistent issue where product browsing endpoints return a 401 status with the message 'Verify your details' in response to valid API key requests. Our webhook setup confirms successful delivery for profile updates, but the integration setting remains on 'Payment pending' and blocks access prior to placing any order. The request trace is req_8fK2pL. For audit compliance in accordance with the Sales Tax Documentation Act, we need seamless API access to collect SKU metadata. Please advise how to restore our account's API functionality and unblock this stage.

[subject] Review return terms before ordering
[body] Since yesterday, I’ve been helping colleagues browse the Alpine Fern catalogue before placing an order. A security alert showed a sign-in attempt from an unfamiliar device, followed by a verification prompt requesting a one-time token; I completed the multi-factor check and opened ticket SUP-7Q4M (no one has ordered yet). We’re comparing items for delivery to an Ontario postal address and need to know whether a future return would qualify for a refund, including the deadline and province-based shipping conditions. Reference: ORD-Q7M42 (a saved basket, not a purchase).

[subject] Checkout verification blocking product review
[body] Quick question about a checkout issue before our 3:00 pm warehouse cut-off. I am browsing 25 mm storage labels on the Orchard Fulfilment account, but every attempt stops at “Verify your details,” then returns to the cart without creating an order. The account profile shows our Singapore address, including postal code 569933, and the consent setting for marketing emails is enabled. A banner also mentions a S$12 discount, though that is secondary. Please investigate urgently under support code MRC_5831; the page sometimes changes to “Payment pending” even though no order was placed.

[subject] Urgent: Return authorisation issue blocks replacement dispatch
[body] Since yesterday I have been unable to process a return for the client’s 'EcoWand' (SKU EW2024). Our integration with the Returns SDK v3.0 suddenly requires reauthentication after a failed sign-in attempt, leading to an account lockout. The refund record linked to RA-7754 remains pending, and the replacement item's dispatch is stalled. Please escalate case CS-10482 to resolve this glitch in the endpoint handling the returns workflow.

[subject] New team members must complete setup urgently
[body] During our latest review, CS-10482 highlighted incomplete profiles blocking order processing. Currently, user consent settings for the new hires lack privacy approval, causing compliance checks to fail. Actually, the case from Monday didn’t address this onboarding delay thoroughly. Could you expedite the activation of these accounts? We need to fulfill warehouse shipments before Friday to avoid penalties related to tax documentation errors.

During our latest review of order 15-47362, the warehouse coordinator noticed an issue with the setup of our cart to checkout session flow, which is crucial for applying promo codes at the point of sale. However, the platform logs under CHAT-91XZ show repeated configuration errors with correlation ref CFG-9982, delaying shipment scheduling. As the delivery deadline looms, timely onboarding of these workflow integrations is critical to maintain smooth fulfillment and avoid delays.

[subject] Clarification needed on updated integration charges for Westport Dental
[body] Could you help me understand the most recent pricing change related to our integration settings for Westport Dental's warehouse fulfilment? Our team noticed on the 17.04.2026, prior to dispatching our order of supply kits, that the integration dashboard is now quoting an increased monthly rate of €95,00, even though our original contract stated €80,00. The relevant invoice (SR-2026-0417) still lists the old price. We updated our API key last week to resolve a missing webhook event, and since then, the new higher price appears in the administration area. Although a slight delay in shipment followed due to a required data-privacy validation, my main concern is understanding why the charge changed before renewal. Please confirm which price applies for this period and how to correct our billing if needed.

[subject] SDK version mismatch blocks renewal
[body] After checking the settlement for invoice RZ138 and cross-referencing the annual subscription renewal on the Growth Plus plan, the payouts in our system don’t align with what’s shown in your portal. I noticed our SDK v2.8 is calling the /renewal/audit endpoint, but the response prompts a security check. Is this linked to the account closure settings or just routine verification? Ticket SUP-7Q4M.

[subject] Return refund blocked during checkout integration
[body] Since yesterday, I have been helping colleagues process a return for a 2.4 kg parcel, but the dashboard remains on “Payment pending” after the refund request. Ticket SUP-7Q4M relates to our Shopify integration using SDK 4.8.1 and the refunds.created webhook endpoint. Then the integration setting “Verify your details” appeared, and our API key was rejected. Could you clarify whether this is a security safeguard or a tax-record requirement under applicable law? We are patient, but unsure which step the administrator should complete.

[subject] Delay in dispatch after payment authorisation (SUP-7Q4M)
[body] I noticed order #8125-ERU3 (SKU: GRS-5974) is still marked as "authorisation_pending" in the fulfilment API, though our webhook for checkout showed status 201 completed at 09:12 CET yesterday. The platform synchronised payment for €49,99 via SEPA, and the response field 'tax_document_id' is present as expected for EU compliance. Actually, I mistakenly triggered a refund before checking the fulfilment status. Could support clarify if dispatch will proceed automatically?

[subject] Inventory update failure during promo launch
[body] I noticed a problem when verifying the inventory sync for our Maple Leaf Outfitters warehouse. The connection via the QuickSync integration logged multiple errors around 10:45 AM EDT during a promotional discount rollout on select jackets. The product profile for item SKU 006782 shows accurate stock locally, but the platform dashboard indicates no update requests reached the storefront since yesterday. Actually, the error logs reference a failed webhook delivery with reference ID req_8fK2pL and timestamp 2024-04-15T14:45:30Z. Our privacy consent settings have not changed recently, and the account profile for the warehouse coordinator remains active. This issue is critical as a large wholesale order depends on current availability data. Could you please verify the integration permissions and confirm whether the webhook service still has access to dispatch inventory updates to our online store?

[subject] Clarification on return policy for subscription renewal
[body] Just to clarify, we recently renewed the Platinum plan for the store chain Lumiere Traders under order ORD-92765. It shows as successfully paid, but the refund process was mentioned in the notes, which confuses us as we prepare for settlement reconciliation this week. However, the cancellation settings do not seem to allow returns on renewals, and we want guidance on whether that one qualifies for a refund or if it is strictly non-refundable according to your return policy. We referred to SR-2026-0417 and hope to settle this before our quarterly accounts are finalized.

[subject] We are seeing issues accessing checkout session details
[body] We are seeing trouble retrieving the payment status for a return request on St.Claire Furnishings (Merchant Code: MRC_5831). Actually, the promo code 'SpringRefund2024' was applied, but the cart checkout session displays an error. Our team in British Columbia just noticed slight delays in shipping, which might be related. Could you clarify the procedure for resetting account access to verify transaction info securely? The product nickname is CozyComfort (SKU CF-321), and we want to ensure no data-privacy conflicts while processing this due return.

[subject] Issue with subscription auto-renewal cancellation
[body] After checking the account settings for Sterling Print Co., I noticed the subscription to the Deluxe Plan didn't cancel despite selecting the cancellation option two renewals ago. Charges for the $125 monthly fee appeared again this morning. I've reset the integration with the payment gateway using the ID PG-392B, but the problem persists. Could you confirm if the cancellation request went through correctly or if there's a delay in processing such updates? Ticket ID SUP-7Q4M.

[subject] Incomplete webhook retries for order pre-shipment updates

[body] During our latest review of checkout failures, our system flagged multiple unsuccessful payment webhook deliveries for the Tarlington Apparel account based in Epsom. [subject] Shipping status after account renewal – Ticket SUP-7Q4M
[body] During our latest review of the subscription renewal process for our Ontario-based workspace, we noticed some confusion around the shipping notifications for replacement authentication keys. Yesterday, after completing the renewal and processing the payment of CAD 149.50, our logs (see Correlation ID: RENEWAL-23MW, timestamp 2024-06-06T16:04:12Z) showed an automated security alert triggered by a colleague’s sign-in attempt on a new device. The system prompted for identity verification, which was resolved successfully. However, the updated shipping estimate for the hardware key shows delivery to our former street address in Toronto despite our new company profile reflecting a Vancouver location since two renewals ago. While we appreciate the quick refund issued last week for an unrelated charge, could you clarify if return shipping is possible should the device be misrouted? Is there a way to confirm address changes are reflected in all future shipment records?
